name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
May 3, 2010
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Certificate of Recognition to League of Women Voters in celebration of their 90th Anniversary.
Presentation of Certificate of Recognition to Lomita Math and Science Magnet School for receiving the California 2010 Distinguished School Award.
Presentation of plaque by Lomita Manor residents to Ron Scanlon for repairs to van.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: March1 and April 6
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report submitting progress report for public works projects. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report submitting March treasury and investment reports. RECEIVE AND FILE.
h.
Report submitting resolution declaring the intention to levy and collect assessments and ordering the public works director/city engineer to prepare and file the report with respect to the maintenance of landscaping with Lomita Landscape Maintenance Assessment District No. 1 for fiscal year commencing July 1, 2010 and ending June 30, 2011. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report submitting contract with Poppin Backhoe Service for $ 119,100 plus $23,000 for unforeseen costs for Lomita Park renovation projects (relocation of electrical switchgear and distribution panel, gas lines, conduit for the security system, and grading and drainage) funded by Prop 40 and Roberti-Z'Berg-Harris Grant funds. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report submitting schedule for FY 2010/11 budget adoption. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
PUBLIC HEARING
6.
PROCUREMENT POLICY Public hearing on an urgency and regular ordinance amending the Lomita Municipal Code to allow adoption of procurement policies specific to the receipt and expenditure of American Recovery and Reinvestment Act Capital Fund Stimulus Grant Funds allocated through the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development, and other Federal or State funding programs.
Presented by Community Services Director McPherron.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
7.
COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS Appointments for vacancies on the Planning Commission (2), Public Safety
8.
NON-CONFORMING RESIDENCES IN COMMERCIAL-GENERAL ZONES Discussion on options for dealing with legal non-conforming residences in commercial-general zones.
Presented by Asst. City Manager Sugano
9.
DISTRIBUTION OF GOLF TOURNAMENT PROCEEDS Discussion of distribution of proceeds from the 2009 golf tournament.
Presented by Special Projects Officer Felix.
10.
FIREWORKS SHOW Discussion of Fireworks Show for Founders Day, June 26. 2010.
Presented by Councilmember King.
CLOSED SESSION
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
